summary: Preserve Node ESM top-level ordering where already-running module microtasks can run before process.nextTick callbacks.

source.pattern: /* ESM top level */ Promise.resolve().then($p); queueMicrotask($m); process.nextTick($t)

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.ordering: Promise and queueMicrotask jobs queued during ESM top-level evaluation run before the newly queued nextTick callback
semantics.reason: ESM evaluation is already executing as part of the microtask queue

caveats: Do not apply CommonJS top-level nextTick precedence to ESM module evaluation.
Ordering after module evaluation enters later ordinary turns follows normal Node queue checkpoints.

tests.name: requires ESM top level
tests.expected_behavior: this rule does not apply; ordinary CommonJS ordering is covered separately
